society.skycraft.say.region.daggerfall: Daggerfall rules the southwestern cape of High Rock—whitewashed Tudor gables, guild bridges over the creek, and a bay harbour that watches Sentinel across the water.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.1: Castle Daggerfall's twin curtain walls have broken three sieges since the First Era, and the harbour boom still rises every dusk.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.2: Tannery Row smells of oak-bark liquor and wet hides whenever the sea-breeze drops along the creek.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.3: King Gothryd and Queen Aubk-i hold court in the great hall while the Elder Council factors count every bale on the quay.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.4: The Knights of the Dragon muster in the upper ward whenever corsair sails are sighted off Glenpoint.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.5: Cross the guild-bridge at noon and you will hear six languages argued over a single bolt of Camlorn broadcloth.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.6: Ilessan Hills tin-miners bring their ingots down the turnpike under armed escort twice a week.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.7: Aldcroft's water-mills grind half the barley that feeds the royal garrison through the winter gales.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.8: Tulune's apple-orchards and hedgerow manors look peaceful enough, until two barons dispute a boundary stone.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.9: Medora Direnni's old tower on Balfiera still draws court mages who think they can untangle High Elven wards.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.10: Every tavern on the South Quay claims its cellar was dug by smugglers before King Lysandus took the throne.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.11: Wait until the fog rolls off the Iliac Bay and you'll understand why our watchmen carry shuttered bullseye lanterns.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.12: The Mages Guild scriptorium in Daggerfall charges three septims just to verify a seal on a charter.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.13: Order of the Dragon squires polish their plate with chalk-dust from the western downs until it shines like silver.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.14: Madam Pelline's ledger-clerks know which merchantmen will clear customs before the harbourmaster even breaks the wax.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.15: No ship rounds the cape without paying light-dues toward the Glenpoint and Betony beacons.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.16: If you buy a house inside the landward wall, make sure the deed is countersigned by the Royal Chamberlain.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.17: Betony's fishing grounds have started more wars between Daggerfall and Sentinel than all the kings' marriages.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.18: Tanner Odo swears the creek water below the bridge tempers leather better than any alum vat in Wayrest.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.19: Even the beggars by Kynareth's porch can recite the lineage of three dukes if there's a copper in it.
society.skycraft.say.daggerfall.20: When the west wind howls off the Abecean, the slate tiles on the high street rattle like castanets.
react.daggerfall.dragon_slayer: By the Dragon of Daggerfall, %1$s—the heralds at Castle Daggerfall have already entered your wyrm-slaying into the royal rolls!
society.skycraft.react.daggerfall.dragon: By the Dragon of Daggerfall, %1$s—the heralds at Castle Daggerfall have already entered your wyrm-slaying into the royal rolls!

society.skycraft.react.daggerfall.compan: A shield-sworn warrior of Jorrvaskr? The Knights of the Dragon salute your mettle on our western roads.

society.skycraft.react.daggerfall.colleg: Our Daggerfall Mages Guild magisters are eager to hear what arcane praxis you bring from Winterhold's towers.

society.skycraft.react.daggerfall.local_: From Tannery Row to the Castle causeway, every guild-house in Daggerfall counts you a steadfast friend.
react.daggerfall.hold_story: Since you quieted the unrest haunting the cape, the coast packets and tin-wagons arrive right on the tide.
society.skycraft.react.daggerfall.hold_s: Since you quieted the unrest haunting the cape, the coast packets and tin-wagons arrive right on the tide.

society.skycraft.react.daggerfall.bounty: Sir Alaric says your bounty tallies have cleared more brigands from the Ilessan hills than two companies of pikemen.

society.skycraft.react.daggerfall.master: The armourers of the Dragon Chapterhouse examined your work and declared it fit for a king's champion.
react.daggerfall.barrow_delver: You have walked out of the barrows and Direnni vaults of the cape with relics the scholars thought lost for an age.

society.skycraft.say.region.glenumbra: Glenumbra's heather moors and chalk headlands stretch from Camlorn's black-slate spires to the fog-shrouded standing stones of the western coast.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.1: Camlorn's black-slate cathedral spires pierce the moorland mist three leagues before you reach the gates.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.2: Never stray off the flagged causeways in Daenia after sundown; the hag-lights in the reed-beds mimic travellers' lanterns.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.3: Glenpoint's headland beacon burns whale-oil through three-day gales so the coasting barks don't split on the reefs.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.4: Northmoor's standing stones were raised long before the first Breton petty-king signed a charter.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.5: Crosswych quarrymen split blue-grey roof slate that covers half the manor-houses between here and Wayrest.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.6: Sheep-drovers on the Glenumbra Moors carry silver-tipped crooks, and not just for ordinary wolves.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.7: At Eagle's Brook the overshot mill-wheel turns day and night on peaty water dark as stout.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.8: Westtry's chalk barrows are sealed with iron grates, and the village reeve checks the padlocks every New Life.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.9: Bellwright Tam in Camlorn casts bronze bells tuned to drive winter fog and ill-luck from the valley.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.10: Lady Hvarine's literary salons in Camlorn set the fashion for every minor court along the western coast.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.11: Peat-cutters around Grimley Tor still dig up bronze spearheads from the old Direnni Hegemony.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.12: The Wyrd sisters in the birch-groves ask no gold, only that you never fell a living rowan tree.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.13: Archpriest Elric's choristers sing evensong in the Cathedral of Mara while rain drums on the flying buttresses.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.14: A wool-merchant from the Moors can tell which hillside a fleece came from just by the smell of the lanolin.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.15: Roadside inns across Glenumbra hang dried rowan and horse-irons over the lintel when the moons are full.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.16: Lord Vidron's dyke-wardens in Daenia spend half the spring clearing bog-willow from the drainage sluices.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.17: Pilot Edda at Glenpoint knows every sandbar and rip-tide from the headland down to Balfiera.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.18: Even the tavern signs in Camlorn are wrought in foliated ironwork by the silver-inlay guild.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.19: When the sea-haar rolls over the moors, you can hear the Northmoor chapel bell tolling through a wall of white.
society.skycraft.say.glenumbra.20: Keep to the high chalk ridgeway if you value dry boots and a whole throat.
react.glenumbra.dragon_slayer: Even the bards of Camlorn have set aside their old romances to compose lays of the dragon-slayer, %1$s!
society.skycraft.react.glenumbra.dragon_: Even the bards of Camlorn have set aside their old romances to compose lays of the dragon-slayer, %1$s!
react.glenumbra.companion_member: A warrior of Jorrvaskr is thrice welcome on the Glenumbra moors, where wolves and worse prowl the heather.
society.skycraft.react.glenumbra.compani: A warrior of Jorrvaskr is thrice welcome on the Glenumbra moors, where wolves and worse prowl the heather.

society.skycraft.react.glenumbra.college: Camlorn's scholarium magisters welcome an arcanist who isn't afraid of ancient standing-stone wards.
react.glenumbra.thieves_member: From Glenpoint's salt-warehouses to Camlorn's silver-lofts, factors check their seals twice when you're in town.
society.skycraft.react.glenumbra.thieves: From Glenpoint's salt-warehouses to Camlorn's silver-lofts, factors check their seals twice when you're in town.

society.skycraft.react.glenumbra.brother: The moor-mist hides many things, traveler, and the cold quiet in your step speaks of the Sanctuary.

society.skycraft.react.glenumbra.local_h: Whether in the quarry-camps of Crosswych or the spires of Camlorn, folk raise their mugs to your name.
react.glenumbra.hold_story: Since you broke the dark covens troubling the moors, the drovers bring their flocks down in peace.
society.skycraft.react.glenumbra.hold_st: Since you broke the dark covens troubling the moors, the drovers bring their flocks down in peace.

society.skycraft.react.glenumbra.master_: Camlorn's silver-wrights and slate-masons alike speak of your craftsmanship as master-grade work.

society.skycraft.say.region.stormhaven: Stormhaven's limestone ridges, fertile corn-lands, and bay coves bridge the great merchant road between Daggerfall and the Bjoulsae.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.1: Alcaire Island claims the birthplace of General Talos, and the innkeeper will show you three different cradles for a coin.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.2: Kambria's double-walled ridge granaries hold enough winter wheat to feed five baronies through a siege.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.3: Koeglin Village shipwrights bend seasoned Stormhaven oak over steam-pits to rib the fastest schooners on the bay.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.4: Limestone quarries along the middle road supply the pale ashlar blocks for every keep in central High Rock.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.5: The Knights of the Flame at Castle Alcaire keep their beacons primed looking out over the sound.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.6: At the Weeping Giant way-station, teamsters swap axle-grease and rumours from twenty fiefs.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.7: Stormhaven's tithe-barns are built like fortresses—slit windows, buttressed stone, and oak doors four inches thick.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.8: Oyster-dredgers off Koeglin bring up old Direnni coins whenever the spring tides scour the bay-mud.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.9: Every hilltop between Alcaire and Kambria has either a knightly watchtower or a windmill turning in the bay breeze.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.10: Chamomile and lavender from Stormhaven's abbey gardens are baled and shipped to perfumers in Wayrest.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.11: When two Stormhaven knights meet at a crossroads, they spend ten minutes establishing whose patent is older.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.12: The coast road past Koeglin floods at the equinoctial springs, sending the stage-coaches up the ridge track.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.13: Coopers in Alcaire char the inside of their oak casks so the island vintage keeps its amber colour.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.14: Mercenary companies muster at the stone bridges every spring hoping for a retainer from a feuding baron.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.15: Even the parish chapels here have crenellated bell-towers in case raiders slip up the river creeks.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.16: Grain-factors at Kambria weigh every sack on bronze steelyards stamped with the seal of Zenithar.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.17: You can smell the pitch-kettles of Koeglin's careening beach half a league down the coast road.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.18: Old legion mile-pillars still stand along the high ridge, worn smooth by centuries of iron-rimmed wains.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.19: A Stormhaven franklin would rather mortgage his plough-oxen than miss the autumn tournament at Alcaire.
society.skycraft.say.stormhaven.20: Blue-slate roofs and pale limestone walls make every town on the ridge gleam after a squall.
react.stormhaven.dragon_slayer: On the island where Talos himself first drew breath, slaying a dragon makes you a living legend, %1$s!
society.skycraft.react.stormhaven.dragon: On the island where Talos himself first drew breath, slaying a dragon makes you a living legend, %1$s!
react.stormhaven.companion_member: The Knights of the Flame at Alcaire honour a shield-brother of Jorrvaskr's ancient line.
society.skycraft.react.stormhaven.compan: The Knights of the Flame at Alcaire honour a shield-brother of Jorrvaskr's ancient line.
react.stormhaven.college_member: Stormhaven's court enchanters are always glad to compare ward-craft with a scholar of the northern College.
society.skycraft.react.stormhaven.colleg: Stormhaven's court enchanters are always glad to compare ward-craft with a scholar of the northern College.

society.skycraft.react.stormhaven.thieve: The customs clerks at Koeglin and Kambria keep a sharp eye on the tithe-chests when you pass through.

society.skycraft.react.stormhaven.brothe: Even along the sunny limestone roads of Stormhaven, folk step aside when they catch that cold shadow in your eyes.

society.skycraft.react.stormhaven.civil_: In the birthplace of the Empire's greatest general, a proven commander of the field commands instant respect.

society.skycraft.react.stormhaven.high_b: The castellan at Kambria recorded your composition fee; the Stormhaven road-wardens have stood down.
react.stormhaven.local_hero: From Koeglin's shipyards to the hill-keep of Alcaire, every hearth in Stormhaven welcomes you.
society.skycraft.react.stormhaven.local_: From Koeglin's shipyards to the hill-keep of Alcaire, every hearth in Stormhaven welcomes you.
react.stormhaven.hold_story: Now that the ridgeway and bay-coves are free of saboteurs, the grain-fleets sail on schedule again.
society.skycraft.react.stormhaven.hold_s: Now that the ridgeway and bay-coves are free of saboteurs, the grain-fleets sail on schedule again.

society.skycraft.react.stormhaven.master: Koeglin's master shipwrights and Alcaire's blade-smiths alike praise the balance of your handiwork.
react.stormhaven.barrow_delver: The old karst vaults beneath the Stormhaven ridges have yielded their long-buried treasures to your torch.
society.skycraft.react.stormhaven.barrow: The old karst vaults beneath the Stormhaven ridges have yielded their long-buried treasures to your torch.
society.skycraft.say.region.anticlere: Anticlere and its sister fiefs of Shalgora, Urvaius, and Ykalon form the warm limestone heart of the Iliac bayshore—vineyards, chalk downs, and ancient charter-towns.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.1: Anticlere's terraced vineyards catch the southern sun off the Iliac Bay, yielding the sweetest vintage in High Rock.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.2: Urvaius chalk-downs pasture ten thousand sheep whose fine wool keeps the fulling-mills clacking all summer.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.3: Shalgora sits in a sheltered karst hollow where heraldic tapestry-weavers work in stone-vaulted halls.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.4: Ykalon's royal foresters guard the tall pine-ridges that supply mast-timber to the bay fleets.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.5: Diplomats from Daggerfall and Wayrest meet at Anticlere's neutral pavilions whenever they need to sign a truce.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.6: The Rotunda of Dibella in Anticlere is paved with warm ochre marble brought across the bay.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.7: Shepherds on the Urvaius ridges build dry-stone folds that have stood since the first Breton charters.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.8: At the Cuckoo and Crown in Shalgora, heralds argue over quarterings of arms until the candles gutter out.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.9: Ykalon's charcoal-burners keep their turf-kilns smoking in the high clearings from Frostfall to Sun's Height.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.10: Orange-blossom and rosemary stills in Anticlere fill corked phials for every noble dressing-table in the province.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.11: A charter-burgess of Ykalon answers only to the town bailiff and the High King's circuit judge.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.12: Chalk-streams below Urvaius run clear over flint gravel, powering six fulling-stocks in a single mile.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.13: Castle Anticlere's bay-bastion flies a gold-and-azure pennon that can be seen from the Balfiera channel.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.14: Tapestry-looms in Shalgora take two winters to weave a single battle-piece for a ducal hall.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.15: Foresters in Ykalon notch their yew-staves in the autumn moon and season them three years in the rafters.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.16: Every spring fair at Urvaius opens with the blessing of the shears at Mara's downland chapel.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.17: Wine-casks rolled down Anticlere's stone quay carry the burnt-brand of the Honourable Vintners.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.18: Even the boundary ditches here are hedged with old hawthorn thick enough to turn a boar-spear.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.19: Travellers between Shalgora and Ykalon rest at stone well-heads carved with Julianos's triangle.
society.skycraft.say.anticlere.20: Warm bay afternoons and petty heraldic feuds—that is Anticlere in a nutshell.
react.anticlere.dragon_slayer: The heralds of Anticlere have blazoned a dragon-slayer's crest in your honour across the treaty halls, %1$s!
society.skycraft.react.anticlere.dragon_: The heralds of Anticlere have blazoned a dragon-slayer's crest in your honour across the treaty halls, %1$s!
react.anticlere.companion_member: Even among Anticlere's courtly knights, a warrior of Jorrvaskr's renown is toasted with the best vintage.
society.skycraft.react.anticlere.compani: Even among Anticlere's courtly knights, a warrior of Jorrvaskr's renown is toasted with the best vintage.
react.anticlere.college_member: The scriptorium masters of Shalgora and Ykalon are delighted to host a scholar from Winterhold.
society.skycraft.react.anticlere.college: The scriptorium masters of Shalgora and Ykalon are delighted to host a scholar from Winterhold.

society.skycraft.react.anticlere.thieves: Anticlere's wine-factors and Urvaius wool-staplers keep their ledger-rooms locked tight when you stroll the arcades.

society.skycraft.react.anticlere.brother: In a region of diplomatic poison and velvet daggers, folk still pale when a true Speaker's blade walks by.

society.skycraft.react.anticlere.civil_w: Envoys at Castle Anticlere study your battle tactics as closely as any First Era chronicle.

society.skycraft.react.anticlere.high_bo: Your composition has been entered into the charter-rolls of Anticlere; the bailiff's men salute you peacefully.
react.anticlere.local_hero: From the pine-woods of Ykalon to Anticlere's sunny quays, every burgess and vintner calls you friend.
society.skycraft.react.anticlere.local_h: From the pine-woods of Ykalon to Anticlere's sunny quays, every burgess and vintner calls you friend.
react.anticlere.hold_story: Since you settled the feud threatening the bay charters, the vintage barges and wool-wains move unmolested.
society.skycraft.react.anticlere.hold_st: Since you settled the feud threatening the bay charters, the vintage barges and wool-wains move unmolested.

society.skycraft.react.anticlere.master_: Anticlere's gilt-smiths and Shalgora's master weavers marvel at the finish on your gear.
react.anticlere.barrow_delver: You have delved the karst-tombs and pine-barrows of the middle fiefs and returned with their oldest secrets.
society.skycraft.react.anticlere.barrow_: You have delved the karst-tombs and pine-barrows of the middle fiefs and returned with their oldest secrets.
society.skycraft.say.region.dwynnen: Dwynnen's salt-weathered granite peninsula juts into the Iliac narrows, where convoy captains and sea-bastions guard the heart of the bay.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.1: Castle Dwynnen's granite sea-wall takes the full weight of the channel chop whenever the tide turns against the wind.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.2: The Convoy Captains' Hall in Dwynnen sets the sailing dates for every merchant fleet heading out of the inner bay.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.3: Rope-walks along Dwynnen's harbour stretch hemp cables a hundred fathoms long smell of Stockholm tar.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.4: Salt-spray crusts the leaded casements of the lower town by noon on any breezy day.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.5: At the Storm-Petrel Inn, retired quartermasters chart every reef and corsair cove from Stros M'Kai to Balfiera.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.6: Dwynnen's iron-keel smithy forges grapnels, swivel-mounts, and cutlasses tough enough to turn a boarding axe.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.7: Sailors' wives hang brass ship-lanterns in the Fane of Kynareth whenever the equinoctial gales blow.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.8: The headland battery above Dwynnen harbour mounts torsion engines that can reach halfway across the roadstead.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.9: Ship-biscuit baked in Dwynnen's stone ovens is hard enough to crack a walnut, but it never moulds at sea.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.10: Careening stages on the shingle beach heel whole brigantines over at low water to scrape the barnacles.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.11: Baronial customs cutters row out in all weathers to inspect the manifests of passing coasters.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.12: Everylintel in the old port is carved from grey peninsula granite that dulls a mason's chisel in an hour.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.13: Scurvy-grass and sea-wormwood tinctures from Dwynnen's apothecary stock every medicine chest in the fleet.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.14: When the fog-bell on the mole rings three strokes, a convoy is warping in through the narrows.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.15: Old sea-dogs on the jetty still argue whether Direnni galleys or Redguard dhows hold the wind closer.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.16: No captain weighs anchor from Dwynnen without pouring a measure of cider over the stem-post for Kynareth.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.17: Driftwood and wrecked spars wash into the lee coves after every winter nor'wester.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.18: The Baron of Dwynnen wears a silver whistle on his collar—the mark of Lord High Admiral of the Narrows.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.19: Herring-busses and naval pinnaces crowd the inner basin three deep when a storm warning flies.
society.skycraft.say.dwynnen.20: Stand on Dwynnen Point on a clear noon and you can see the white sails of twenty fiefs.

society.skycraft.say.region.wayrest: Wayrest crowns the head of the Iliac Bay at the mouth of the Bjoulsae—a canal-laced metropolis of merchant syndicates, royal intrigue, and chained harbours.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.1: Wayrest's great iron harbour chain winches up between the twin towers whenever an untaxed hull approaches the mouth.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.2: House Gardner, House Cumberland, and House Horley buy and sell baronies in the arcaded Bourse before breakfast.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.3: The Bjoulsae barges bring Wrothgar iron, Evermor wool, and Bangkorai copper straight to the Chain Quay warehouses.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.4: Step off the marble bridges of the Palace ring into the lower canals and keep one hand on your purse-strings.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.5: King Eadwyre's court is a chessboard where Queen Barenziah, Elysana, and Helseth each move three pieces at once.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.6: At the Silver Lantern on the quay, factors settle bills of exchange drawn on banks from Sentinel to the Imperial City.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.7: Dreughside's lagoon fishers boil dreugh-wax and purple shell-dye that smells across half the estuary.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.8: Wayrest's catacombs run beneath the oldest guild-halls, and not all the iron gates down there stay locked.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.9: The Chapel-Bourse of Zenithar in Wayrest weighs gold sovereigns on balances accurate to a single grain of barley.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.10: Canal-punts poles past mossy stone foundations while velvet-cloaked syndics watch from the upper loggias.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.11: Quartermaster Jules at the Admiralty dock can spot a forged bill of lading at twenty paces.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.12: Lady Morgiah's salon hears every whisper in the Western Reach before the royal couriers even change horses.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.13: Wait by the Harbour Chain Tower at flood tide and watch fifty river-barges lock through into the bay basin.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.14: The Cloudy Dregs Inn down by the sluice-gates asks no names and serves spiced wine that could strip varnish.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.15: Pontanian corsair-factors walk the Wayrest quays in broad daylight wearing letters of marque signed by the Council.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.16: Every guild-house on the Grand Canal maintains its own liveried watermen and iron-grated counting-room.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.17: Sister Odelle at the Chapel of the Divines tends the alms-box and hears the confessions of half the Chancery.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.18: Fog off the Bjoulsae fen mixes with coal-smoke from the assay furnaces to turn Wayrest evenings silver-grey.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.19: In Daggerfall they ask who your grandfather was; in Wayrest they ask what your cargo is worth.
society.skycraft.say.wayrest.20: Even the stone gargoyles on Castle Wayrest look as though they are calculating interest.
react.wayrest.dragon_slayer: Even the jaded merchant-princes of Wayrest left their counting-tables when word arrived that you slew a dragon, %1$s!
society.skycraft.react.wayrest.dragon_sl: Even the jaded merchant-princes of Wayrest left their counting-tables when word arrived that you slew a dragon, %1$s!

society.skycraft.react.wayrest.companion: Honest steel from Jorrvaskr is a rare commodity in Wayrest's halls of intrigue—you are welcome here.

react.wayrest.hold_story: Since you untangled the syndicate plot in the canals, the Bjoulsae trade-fleets move without extortion.
society.skycraft.react.wayrest.hold_stor: Since you untangled the syndicate plot in the canals, the Bjoulsae trade-fleets move without extortion.

society.skycraft.react.wayrest.bounty_hu: Estuary pirates and highwaymen around Dreughside have scattered since you started collecting the Council's bounties.

society.skycraft.react.wayrest.barrow_de: You have walked the deepest flooded vaults beneath Wayrest's catacombs and returned with the seal intact.
society.skycraft.say.region.rivenspire: Rivenspire's jagged basalt crags and wind-scoured moors rise from the red-slate ramparts of Shornhelm to the storm-battered cliffs of Northpoint.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.1: Shornhelm's Red Keep commands the only wagon-pass splitting the Rivenspire crags between north and south.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.2: Northpoint's lighthouse fog-horn booms across the cold northern sea whenever the pack-mist rolls in.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.3: Every manor-house in Rivenspire bolts iron grilles over its cellar vents and hangs garlic braid by the eaves.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.4: At Crestshade, the ravine road runs under basalt overhangs so steep the sun only hits the cobbles at noon.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.5: Hoarfrost Downs shepherds fold their flocks inside eight-foot stone walls before the first star appears.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.6: Fell's Run barley-fields are the one green ribbon in forty leagues of grey rock and crimson heather.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.7: Marshal Ysolde's pikemen drill on the Shornhelm muster-ground under banners the colour of dried blood.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.8: Alder the Fletcher in Shornhelm binds ash-wood crossbow prods with horn and sinew that can punch through plate.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.9: Keeper Sorley at Northpoint tends a beacon-fire fed with whale-oil and pitch from the northern fisheries.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.10: The Doomcrag's broken Ayleid spire still looms on the western horizon like a splintered black tooth.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.11: Peat-Cutter Gill swears the bogs behind Northpoint preserve oak logs that fell in the Merethic Era.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.12: House Dorell, House Tamrith, and House Montclair watch each other across the Shornhelm council table like hawks.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.13: The half-roofed Moor Chapel at Northpoint lets the sea-gale blow straight across the altar stone.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.14: Travel the ravine road after dusk without a silver-edged blade and you are asking for a short journey.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.15: Herring-smokers on Northpoint's cliff-stages cure their catch over smouldering peat and juniper brush.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.16: Even the wayside shrines of Arkay in Rivenspire are built like blockhouses with iron-studded doors.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.17: In Fell's Run they ring the croft-bell at twilight so herdsmen in the mist can find the gate.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.18: Black basalt ashlar and dark crimson slate give every town in the crags a stern, unbroken profile.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.19: Sergeant Brom at the Red Keep checks every traveller's pass before the portcullis rises an inch.
society.skycraft.say.rivenspire.20: The wind off the northern ocean tastes of salt, sleet, and old stone.
react.rivenspire.dragon_slayer: A dragon brought down among the crags of Rivenspire! The Red Keep's trumpets sounded in your honour, %1$s!
society.skycraft.react.rivenspire.dragon: A dragon brought down among the crags of Rivenspire! The Red Keep's trumpets sounded in your honour, %1$s!
react.rivenspire.companion_member: In a grim land of crags and night-terrors, a shield-sibling of Jorrvaskr is the finest ally Shornhelm could ask for.
society.skycraft.react.rivenspire.compan: In a grim land of crags and night-terrors, a shield-sibling of Jorrvaskr is the finest ally Shornhelm could ask for.

society.skycraft.react.rivenspire.colleg: The Order of the Lamp in Shornhelm welcomes an arcanist whose wards hold firm against the dark.

react.rivenspire.local_hero: From Fell's Run's pastures to Northpoint's wind-swept quay, Rivenspire calls you its staunchest defender.
society.skycraft.react.rivenspire.local_: From Fell's Run's pastures to Northpoint's wind-swept quay, Rivenspire calls you its staunchest defender.

society.skycraft.react.rivenspire.master: Alder the Fletcher and the smiths of the Red Anvil say your craft is the finest in the northern marches.

society.skycraft.say.region.bjoulsae: The Bjoulsae River valley winds from the island cathedral of Evermor and the scholar-bluffs of Bhoriane to the northern sea-keep of Farrun.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.1: Evermor sits on its river-lake island linked to the banks by a stone causeway arch where every barge pays toll.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.2: Bhoriane's river-bluff scriptoriums copy charters and star-tables for every court between Wayrest and Elinhir.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.3: Menevia's great abbey bell-spire rings the canonical hours across three miles of walled orchards and flax-fields.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.4: Phrygias guards the high granite col where the wool-trains climb out of the river basin toward Wrothgar.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.5: Up on the northern coast, Farrun's sea-wall keep blends Breton stone bastions with heavy Nordic timber longhalls.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.6: Horse-tribesmen and Breton drovers water their herds on opposite gravel bars along the middle Bjoulsae.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.7: Ferrywoman Iselle poles passengers across Evermor's misty reach before the causeway gates open at dawn.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.8: Bishop Mallory at Evermor Cathedral guards the illuminated river-compacts signed in the Second Era.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.9: Alluvial gold panned from the Bjoulsae tributaries is weighed and stamped at Evermor's assay house.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.10: In Farrun you will hear Nordic skalds and Breton troubadours arguing over the same mead-bench.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.11: Lamplighter Vey walks Evermor's causeway arch every evening lighting oil-cressets against the river fog.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.12: Bhoriane's ink-makers boil oak-galls and copperas from the Bangkorai foothills to make indelible chancery ink.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.13: Pilgrims bound for Menevia Abbey carry carved ash-staves blessed at the river-fords.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.14: At the Windy Saddle Inn in Phrygias, muleteers wrap their boots in sheepskin before tackling the northern pass.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.15: Towpath teams of four Shire horses haul flat-bottomed timber-barges upstream against the Bjoulsae current.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.16: Bangkorai Pass lies just south of Evermor's walls, so the ducal watch always sleeps with crossbows spanned.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.17: Farrun's ice-axe smiths temper their steel in brine so it won't snap in a Sea of Ghosts gale.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.18: Flax-bleacheries in the Menevia valley spread white linen across the riverside meadows every Sun's Height.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.19: The Bjoulsae is High Rock's silver highway—choke the river and twenty towns go hungry.
society.skycraft.say.bjoulsae.20: Mud-brick, river cobble, and seasoned spruce give the valley towns a warmth you won't find on the crags.
react.bjoulsae.dragon_slayer: From Farrun's ice-wall down to Evermor's island cathedral, the Bjoulsae valley rings with the tale of your dragon-slaying, %1$s!
society.skycraft.react.bjoulsae.dragon_s: From Farrun's ice-wall down to Evermor's island cathedral, the Bjoulsae valley rings with the tale of your dragon-slaying, %1$s!
react.bjoulsae.companion_member: In Farrun and along the Bjoulsae, folk know the honour of Jorrvaskr—your shield is welcome at every hearth.
society.skycraft.react.bjoulsae.companio: In Farrun and along the Bjoulsae, folk know the honour of Jorrvaskr—your shield is welcome at every hearth.
react.bjoulsae.college_member: The scriptorium masters of Bhoriane are eager to exchange arcane treatises with a mage of Winterhold.
society.skycraft.react.bjoulsae.college_: The scriptorium masters of Bhoriane are eager to exchange arcane treatises with a mage of Winterhold.
react.bjoulsae.thieves_member: The toll-clerks on Evermor's causeway arch keep both hands on the strongbox when you stroll across the span.
society.skycraft.react.bjoulsae.thieves_: The toll-clerks on Evermor's causeway arch keep both hands on the strongbox when you stroll across the span.
react.bjoulsae.brotherhood_member: Even the hard-bitten river-barge crews fall silent when your shadow crosses the wharf.
society.skycraft.react.bjoulsae.brotherh: Even the hard-bitten river-barge crews fall silent when your shadow crosses the wharf.
react.bjoulsae.civil_war_hero: At the gateway to Bangkorai Pass, Evermor's garrison salutes a warrior tested in real battle.
society.skycraft.react.bjoulsae.civil_wa: At the gateway to Bangkorai Pass, Evermor's garrison salutes a warrior tested in real battle.

society.skycraft.react.bjoulsae.high_bou: Duke Guimard's chancery has sealed your quittance; the river-wardens from Menevia to Farrun have stood down.
react.bjoulsae.local_hero: Every barge-master, abbey-monk, and towpath smith along the Bjoulsae hails you as a true friend of the valley.
society.skycraft.react.bjoulsae.local_he: Every barge-master, abbey-monk, and towpath smith along the Bjoulsae hails you as a true friend of the valley.
react.bjoulsae.hold_story: Since you secured the river-fords and pass approaches, the Bjoulsae barges run without fear of ambush.
society.skycraft.react.bjoulsae.hold_sto: Since you secured the river-fords and pass approaches, the Bjoulsae barges run without fear of ambush.
react.bjoulsae.bounty_hunter: The highwaymen who used to lurk in the Phrygias col have vanished since you took up the bounty rolls.
society.skycraft.react.bjoulsae.bounty_h: The highwaymen who used to lurk in the Phrygias col have vanished since you took up the bounty rolls.
react.bjoulsae.master_craftsman: Evermor's gold-assayers and Farrun's iron-wrights alike praise the mastery of your craft.
society.skycraft.react.bjoulsae.master_c: Evermor's gold-assayers and Farrun's iron-wrights alike praise the mastery of your craft.
react.bjoulsae.barrow_delver: You have delved the river-bluff vaults and frost-barrows of the north and walked out with their ancient hoard.
society.skycraft.react.bjoulsae.barrow_d: You have delved the river-bluff vaults and frost-barrows of the north and walked out with their ancient hoard.
society.skycraft.say.region.wrothgar: Wrothgar's iron-rich peaks and alpine valleys house the stepped basalt bastions of Orsinium, the clan strongholds of the Orcs, and the fjord-town of Jehanna.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.1: Orsinium's Great Gate-Hammer hangs over basalt ramparts raised by King Gortwog and the iron-clans of Wrothgar.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.2: The Great Forge pit at the heart of Orsinium never goes cold; its coal-smoke stains the snow on the peaks above.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.3: Clan Morkul's blast-smelters tap deep orichalcum and iron veins straight out of the mountain wall.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.4: Clan Tumnosh quarrymen dress six-ton basalt blocks and haul them on echatere sledges down the pass.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.5: Clan Fharun's cliff-longhouse watches the frozen northern sea where ice-floes grind against the rocks.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.6: In Jehanna's fjord-harbour, Breton factors and Nordic trappers trade mammoth-fur, seal-oil, and Skyrim amber.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.7: Gavaudon's crag-bastion sits on the western march where Breton crossbowmen and Orc outriders eye each other across the gorge.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.8: King Gortwog and Chief Gulmak argue day and night whether Trinimac's priesthood or Malacath's code rules the citadel.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.9: Echatere herds with shaggy coats and four curved horns carry every load that would break a lowland horse.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.10: Smith-Mother Ushra tests every breastplate forged in Orsinium with a two-handed war-maul before it leaves the anvil.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.11: Skald Torog chants the grudge-rolls in the Trophy Hall while roast echatere ribs spit over the fire-trench.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.12: Never enter an Orc stronghold uninvited unless you carry blood-kin token or a master smith's tribute.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.13: At the Bone and Ember in Orsinium, highland spiced ale is served in horn-mugs banded with blackened iron.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.14: Jehanna's wind-fane honours both Kynareth and Kyne, so neither the Breton pilots nor the Nord whalers take offence.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.15: Avalanche-sheds of heavy spruce timber roof the switchback trails between Phrygias and the Orsinium gate.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.16: In the Hall of the Grudge-Urns, the ashes of fallen warriors are sealed in iron vessels forged from their own shields.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.17: Frost-bears and crag-wolves prowl the pine-line whenever the early blizzards drive the mountain goats down.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.18: An Orsinium mason fits cyclopean stone without mortar so the frost-heave cannot crack the bastion wall.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.19: Even the border-tolls at Gavaudon are paid in weighed iron bars as often as stamped gold coin.
society.skycraft.say.wrothgar.20: Stand on the Trophy Gate at dawn and watch the forge-sparks rise against the glaciers of the Druadach.
react.wrothgar.dragon_slayer: By Mauloch's iron hand and Trinimac's blade, %1$s—even the war-chiefs of Orsinium roar approval at your dragon-slaying!
society.skycraft.react.wrothgar.dragon_s: By Mauloch's iron hand and Trinimac's blade, %1$s—even the war-chiefs of Orsinium roar approval at your dragon-slaying!
react.wrothgar.companion_member: A warrior of Jorrvaskr carries honour that both Jehanna's thanes and Orsinium's clan-chiefs respect.
